## Constants

<a name="ansiEraseStatus"></a>ansiEraseStatus returns to the beginning of the status line and clears it.

```go
const ansiEraseStatus = "\r\x1b[K"
```

<a name="frameInterval"></a>frameInterval is the delay between spinner frame advances.

```go
const frameInterval = 100 * time.Millisecond
```

<a name="spinnerFrameRunes"></a>spinnerFrameRunes spells the braille animation frames in display order.

```go
const spinnerFrameRunes = "⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏"
```

<a name="ConfirmOneWordPrompt"></a>
## func [ConfirmOneWordPrompt](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/internal/terminal/prompt.go#L16>)

```go
func ConfirmOneWordPrompt(input io.Reader, destination io.Writer, prompt string, interactive, styled bool) (canceled bool, err error)
```

ConfirmOneWordPrompt asks whether to submit a one\-word prompt when interaction is enabled. It reads one reply from input and treats n and no as cancellation, regardless of case. Prompt and input failures retain their original causes.

<a name="IsTerminal"></a>
## func [IsTerminal](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/internal/terminal/terminal.go#L12>)

```go
func IsTerminal(stream any) bool
```

IsTerminal reports whether the supplied stream is an actual terminal file. Non\-file readers and writers, nil files, pipes, and ordinary devices return false.

<a name="readReply"></a>
## func [readReply](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/internal/terminal/prompt.go#L51>)

```go
func readReply(input io.Reader) (string, error)
```

readReply reads and trims one line without consuming bytes from a later reply. EOF returns the available reply; other read failures retain their cause.

<a name="Spinner"></a>
## type [Spinner](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/internal/terminal/spinner.go#L27-L46>)

Spinner animates a generation status until completion, cancellation, or a write failure.

```go
type Spinner struct {
    // destination receives status frames and the final erase sequence.
    destination io.Writer
    // startedAt anchors the elapsed counter.
    startedAt time.Time
    // ticker schedules frame advances.
    ticker *time.Ticker
    // done requests animation shutdown when closed.
    done chan struct{}
    // animated closes after animation and its cleanup finish.
    animated chan struct{}
    // media selects the image or video status label.
    media media.Kind
    // frameIndex selects the current animation frame modulo the frame count.
    frameIndex int
    // finished records that Finish has already returned a duration.
    finished bool
    // finalElapsed preserves the duration returned by repeated Finish calls.
    finalElapsed time.Duration
}
```

<a name="StartSpinner"></a>
### func [StartSpinner](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/internal/terminal/spinner.go#L50>)

```go
func StartSpinner(ctx context.Context, destination io.Writer, mediaKind media.Kind) *Spinner
```

StartSpinner renders the first status frame and starts animation on destination. A write failure stops the animation without affecting generation.

<a name="Spinner.Finish"></a>
### func \(\*Spinner\) [Finish](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/internal/terminal/spinner.go#L73>)

```go
func (spinner *Spinner) Finish() time.Duration
```

Finish stops and waits for animation, returning the elapsed duration. Repeated calls return the same duration without writing again.

<a name="Spinner.animate"></a>
### func \(\*Spinner\) [animate](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/internal/terminal/spinner.go#L88>)

```go
func (spinner *Spinner) animate(ctx context.Context)
```

animate advances frames until completion, cancellation, or a write failure. It then attempts to clear the status line.
